ticket.subject: App not loading for anyone
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Writing on behalf of Saltmarsh Robotics. Since 14:35 UTC, nobody in our Boston and Portland offices can load the dashboard.

Contacts at two other companies tell us they see the same thing. Honestly, this is really frustrating.

We have a hard deadline tomorrow morning, so please treat this as urgent. Is there an incident on your side?

Thanks,
Mei Delacroix
founder, Saltmarsh Robotics
